method: Start from dated Tim-originated language/events, then map later biblical comparators. Preserve source direction: Timic statement/event first; biblical comparison second unless the conversation itself already invoked Scripture.

reverse_findings: The April 9 paired-guardian/narrow-gate architecture predates the later explicit Eden-cherubim / sanctuary-veil comparison, making that comparison a genuine reverse-direction discovery rather than an assistant-generated starting point.

Jachin and Boaz were already named in Tim's September 5 synthesis, so Pillar/Axis biblical work should be routed as an expansion of user-originated Temple-pillar material, not a wholly new assistant motif.

Lamp/light, single Eye, Stone, mustard seed, branches, House and Ladder were all present together in Tim's September 8 motif inventory before the Zechariah 3-4 Stone/Seven-Eyes/Lampstand research wave was created on September 9.

The project repeatedly moves from isolated symbols into sequences: Garden→Gate→Heaven; Root→Branch; Stone→Eye; Seed→death→growth; House→Door→Ladder; North→Axis→Heaven. These sequences are more evidentially interesting than isolated word matches.

Several strong biblical overlaps are explicit from the beginning (Lion of Judah, Root of David/Jesse, Moshiach, New Jerusalem), while others are retrospective structural comparators (cherubim guardians, Zechariah lampstand/seven eyes, Hebrews veil/body access). Keeping those classes separate is essential.
